test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY), which is being implemented by the National Health Authority (NHA) in partnership with state governments, a health cover of up to what amount per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation is being provided, as on August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹5 lakhs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is one of the **world’s largest health insurance schemes** financed by the government of India. 
 
• Coverage of **Rs.5 lakh per family **per annum for secondary and tertiary care across public and private hospitals.
 
• Approximately **50 crore beneficiaries **(over 10 crore poor and vulnerable entitled families) are eligible for the scheme.
 
• **Cashless hospitalization.**
 
• Covers up to **3 days of pre-hospitalization expenses** such as medicines and diagnostics.
 
• Covers up to **15 days of post-hospitalization expenses** which include medicines and diagnostics.
 
• **No restriction** on family size, gender, or age.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY):**​

 
 
• 
 
The largest government-funded health assurance programme in the world is called AB-PMJAY.

 
 
• 
 
For secondary and tertiary hospitalizations, AB-PMJAY offers health assurance of up to Rs. 5 Lakh per family per year.

 
 
• 
 
The AB-PMJAY programme is entirely cashless and paperless.

 
 
• 
 
The advantages of AB-PMJAY are transferable throughout the nation.

 
 
• 
 
No restrictions on family size, age, or gender exist.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**National Health Authority (NHA):**

 
 
• 
 
The "Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana" is India's premier public health insurance/assurance programme, and the **National Health Authority (NHA)** is **in charge **of putting it into action.

 
 
• 
 
Additionally, the NHA is in charge of** developing the technological foundation** and carrying out the "National Digital Health Mission" to establish a National Digital Health Eco-system.
